issues.description: Method name mismatch for the 3-qubit QFT routine: the problem statement tasks refer to implementing a QFT routine (Exercise 6.1) and the solution implements a public method named qft_circuit(self, qc), but the template declares the method as _qft_circuit(self, qc) (leading underscore). This mismatch is structural: tests or instructor code that expect qft_circuit will not find the student implementation if they follow the template, causing failing tests or confusion about which method to implement.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the template and solution method names consistent. Rename the template method _qft_circuit(self, qc) to qft_circuit(self, qc) (remove the leading underscore) so it matches the solution and the exercise/test expectation, or alternatively rename the solution/test reference to _qft_circuit. Ensure the inverse method calls the same method name (e.g., qft_circuit) to avoid further mismatches.
